latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Generation Gemini v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate AI-powered 1080p videos from text prompts; no editing or filming skills needed.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF (up to 500MB) and returns ready-to-use MP4 files.
- Simple onboarding with automatic free trial token for new users.
- Full workflow: upload, edit, preview, check credits/status, and export with clear user prompts.
- Session-based system preserves drafts and media, enabling iterative editing and fast cloud rendering.
- Handles errors gracefully and guides users for registration, credits, and supported formats.
